items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I worked with Mac for years myself over in Pensacola. But Mac and I, we was going on the road all the time.

ctx.x: With Mac Merrimaker. See? Mac from out of New Orleans. And I worked with Mac for years myself over in Pensacola. But Mac and I, we was going on the road all the time. See, we was on the road. Very soon we had to clear a dance in Pensacola. We was going to go all the time.
But Mac didn't have the band himself, huh?
